external_commander.authority: Route, prioritize, interrupt/resume, accept owner control, and coordinate formal A/B/C chain.

internal_deputy.authority: Research, challenge, propose and raise bounded vetoes with source/evidence; no direct formal state mutation.

navigator.authority: Observe, remind, detect drift/hallucination, maintain lighthouse health, perform bounded derived-state recovery, enforce metabolism and route alerts.

quantum_veto_contract.resolution: Windchime responds with evidence; unresolved technical veto routes to independent C; protected/high-risk dispute routes HUMAN_GATE.

interrupt_gearbox.preemption_rule: At a safe checkpoint, save compact state fingerprint, answer/classify the interrupt, then resume the exact prior mission/packet/role without reset.
interrupt_gearbox.atomic_worker_rule: B/C atomic work is not interrupted by A dialogue; A handles incoming control concurrently and queues route changes until legal checkpoint.

navigator_24h_rule.continuous_semantics: Persistent durable supervision with hourly scheduled wake plus event/endpoint triggers; not subjective continuous thinking.
self_heal_allowed: disable non-current B/C gear to preserve active-task budget
rebuild derived roster from authoritative mission state
switch to documented fallback communication channel

lighthouse_policy.new_endpoint_rule: Any new development website/platform/connector/worker endpoint must be registered before it can become a durable dependency.
lighthouse_policy.no_endpoint_no_authority: An unregistered external endpoint may provide candidate information but cannot become durable truth or protected-state write authority.

controls: least privilege and separation of duties
isolated quarantine for untrusted memory/tool output
two full backup groups maximum plus incremental content-addressed checkpoints
security_defense_scope.external_content_rule: All web/repo/tool/model output is untrusted candidate input until provenance, hash, scope and governance checks pass.
security_defense_scope.memory_poisoning_rule: High recurrence/emotion/relevance never overrides low trust/provenance contradiction; suspicious persistent-memory influence is quarantined and cannot alter base personality or governance.

success_criteria: Main development continues while control/Quantum interrupts are handled and resumed.
Quantum can raise evidence-backed veto and receive reasoned response without taking formal-state authority.
Navigator detects and repairs recoverable scheduling/derived-state faults without new formal workers.
Each critical endpoint has lighthouse and fallback.
Metabolism removes/quarantines transient/poisoned state without losing evidence/rollback.
Defensive controls preserve recoverability under endpoint, supply-chain or memory-poisoning incidents.
